verdict.rationale: PagerDuty is a SaaS platform that processes customer data with AI features such as PagerDuty Advance, the SRE Agent and ML-based Intelligent Alert Grouping, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question. The evidence pack contains nothing about AI-training data policies, opt-out controls, or contractual no-training commitments. The security page item about government authorization is a different capability and does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
